title: Build a FastAPI Backend with Database
description: Set up a FastAPI project with SQLAlchemy, create models, and build CRUD API endpoints
objective: Students will create a fully working FastAPI backend with database models, CRUD endpoints, Pydantic validation, and seed data for a student management system

steps.title: Set Up the Project Structure
steps.instructions:
Create a new project folder and set up the Python environment:

```bash
mkdir smartattend-capstone
cd smartattend-capstone

# Create virtual environment
python -m venv venv

# Activate it (Windows)
venv\Scripts\activate

# Install dependencies
pip install fastapi uvicorn sqlalchemy[asyncio] aiosqlite pydantic[email] python-dotenv
```

Create the project folder structure:

```bash
mkdir -p app data tests
```

Create these empty files:
- `app/__init__.py`
- `app/main.py`
- `tests/__init__.py`
- `.env`
- `.env.example`
- `.gitignore`

Add this to `.env`:
```
DATABASE_URL=sqlite+aiosqlite:///./data/capstone.db
SECRET_KEY=my-dev-secret-key
```

Add this to `.env.example` (no real values — this gets committed to Git):
```
DATABASE_URL=sqlite+aiosqlite:///./data/capstone.db
SECRET_KEY=change-me
```

Add this to `.gitignore`:
```
venv/
.env
data/*.db
__pycache__/
```

steps.title: Create Database Models
steps.instructions:
Open `app/main.py` and add the database setup and models.

Start with imports and configuration:

```python
import os
from datetime import datetime, date
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from typing import Optional

from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, HTTPException, Query
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, EmailStr
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Boolean, Date, DateTime, ForeignKey, select, func
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import create_async_engine, async_sessionmaker, AsyncSession
from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase, relationship
from dotenv import load_dotenv

load_dotenv()

DATABASE_URL = os.getenv("DATABASE_URL", "sqlite+aiosqlite:///./data/capstone.db")

engine = create_async_engine(DATABASE_URL, echo=True)
async_session = async_sessionmaker(engine, class_=AsyncSession, expire_on_commit=False)


class Base(DeclarativeBase):
    pass


async def get_db():
    async with async_session() as session:
        try:
            yield session
            await session.commit()
        except Exception:
            await session.rollback()
            raise
```

Now add the Student and Attendance models:

```python
class Student(Base):
    __tablename__ = "students"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    name = Column(String(100), nullable=False)
    email = Column(String(200), unique=True, nullable=False)
    phone = Column(String(15))
    batch = Column(String(50))
    city = Column(String(50))
    is_active = Column(Boolean, default=True)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)
    attendances = relationship("Attendance", back_populates="student")


class Attendance(Base):
    __tablename__ = "attendances"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    student_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey("students.id"), nullable=False)
    date = Column(Date, nullable=False)
    status = Column(String(10), nullable=False)
    marked_by = Column(String(100))
    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow)
    student = relationship("Student", back_populates="attendances")
```

Save the file. We will add endpoints in the next steps.

steps.title: Add Pydantic Schemas and App Setup
steps.instructions:
Below your models in `app/main.py`, add Pydantic schemas for request/response validation:

```python
# --- Pydantic Schemas ---

class StudentCreate(BaseModel):
    name: str
    email: EmailStr
    phone: Optional[str] = None
    batch: Optional[str] = None
    city: Optional[str] = None


class StudentResponse(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)
    id: int
    name: str
    email: str
    phone: Optional[str]
    batch: Optional[str]
    city: Optional[str]
    is_active: bool
    created_at: datetime


class AttendanceCreate(BaseModel):
    student_id: int
    date: date
    status: str
    marked_by: Optional[str] = None


class AttendanceResponse(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)
    id: int
    student_id: int
    date: date
    status: str
    marked_by: Optional[str]
    created_at: datetime
```

Now add the FastAPI app setup:

```python
@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    async with engine.begin() as conn:
        await conn.run_sync(Base.metadata.create_all)
    print("Database ready. Open http://localhost:8000/docs")
    yield


app = FastAPI(
    title="SmartAttend API",
    version="1.0.0",
    description="Student Attendance API for TechPath Institute",
    lifespan=lifespan,
)

app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["*"],
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)


@app.get("/api/v1/health")
async def health():
    return {"status": "ok"}
```

Test it:
```bash
uvicorn app.main:app --reload
```

Open http://localhost:8000/docs — you should see Swagger UI with the health endpoint.

steps.title: Build CRUD Endpoints
steps.instructions:
Add these endpoints below your app setup in `app/main.py`:

```python
# --- Student Endpoints ---

@app.post("/api/v1/students", response_model=StudentResponse, status_code=201)
async def create_student(data: StudentCreate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):
    existing = await db.execute(select(Student).where(Student.email == data.email))
    if existing.scalar_one_or_none():
        raise HTTPException(409, "Email already exists")
    student = Student(**data.model_dump())
    db.add(student)
    await db.flush()
    await db.refresh(student)
    return student


@app.get("/api/v1/students", response_model=list[StudentResponse])
async def list_students(
    skip: int = 0, limit: int = 20,
    batch: Optional[str] = None,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
):
    query = select(Student).where(Student.is_active == True)
    if batch:
        query = query.where(Student.batch == batch)
    query = query.offset(skip).limit(limit)
    result = await db.execute(query)
    return result.scalars().all()


@app.get("/api/v1/students/{student_id}", response_model=StudentResponse)
async def get_student(student_id: int, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):
    result = await db.execute(select(Student).where(Student.id == student_id))
    student = result.scalar_one_or_none()
    if not student:
        raise HTTPException(404, "Student not found")
    return student


# --- Attendance Endpoints ---

@app.post("/api/v1/attendance", response_model=AttendanceResponse, status_code=201)
async def mark_attendance(data: AttendanceCreate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):
    result = await db.execute(select(Student).where(Student.id == data.student_id))
    if not result.scalar_one_or_none():
        raise HTTPException(404, "Student not found")
    if data.status not in ("present", "absent", "late"):
        raise HTTPException(400, "Status must be present, absent, or late")
    att = Attendance(**data.model_dump())
    db.add(att)
    await db.flush()
    await db.refresh(att)
    return att


@app.get("/api/v1/students/{student_id}/attendance", response_model=list[AttendanceResponse])
async def student_attendance(student_id: int, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):
    result = await db.execute(
        select(Attendance).where(Attendance.student_id == student_id).order_by(Attendance.date.desc())
    )
    return result.scalars().all()
```

Restart the server and test each endpoint in Swagger UI:
1. Create a student (POST /api/v1/students) with name "Rahul Sharma", email "rahul@example.com", city "Bhopal"
2. List students (GET /api/v1/students)
3. Get student by ID (GET /api/v1/students/1)
4. Mark attendance (POST /api/v1/attendance) for student_id 1
5. Get attendance (GET /api/v1/students/1/attendance)

steps.title: Add Seed Data and Report Endpoint
steps.instructions:
Add a seed endpoint and a report endpoint to `app/main.py`:

```python
# --- Seed Data ---

@app.post("/api/v1/seed")
async def seed_db(db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):
    students = [
        Student(name="Rahul Sharma", email="rahul@example.com", phone="9876543210", batch="PFS-2026-July", city="Bhopal"),
        Student(name="Priya Patel", email="priya@example.com", phone="9876543211", batch="PFS-2026-July", city="Pune"),
        Student(name="Ananya Gupta", email="ananya@example.com", phone="9876543212", batch="PFS-2026-July", city="Delhi"),
        Student(name="Vikram Singh", email="vikram@example.com", phone="9876543213", batch="PFS-2026-Aug", city="Jaipur"),
        Student(name="Neha Reddy", email="neha@example.com", phone="9876543214", batch="PFS-2026-Aug", city="Hyderabad"),
    ]
    for s in students:
        existing = await db.execute(select(Student).where(Student.email == s.email))
        if not existing.scalar_one_or_none():
            db.add(s)
    await db.flush()

    dates = [date(2026, 7, d) for d in [1, 2, 3, 4, 7, 8]]
    for d in dates:
        db.add(Attendance(student_id=1, date=d, status="present" if d.day != 3 else "absent", marked_by="Amit Sir"))
        db.add(Attendance(student_id=2, date=d, status="present" if d.day not in [2, 7] else "absent", marked_by="Amit Sir"))
        db.add(Attendance(student_id=3, date=d, status="present" if d.day in [1, 4] else "absent", marked_by="Amit Sir"))
    await db.flush()
    return {"message": "Seeded 5 students and 18 attendance records"}


# --- Report ---

@app.get("/api/v1/reports/attendance")
async def attendance_report(batch: str = Query(...), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):
    result = await db.execute(select(Student).where(Student.batch == batch))
    students = result.scalars().all()
    report = []
    for s in students:
        total_r = await db.execute(select(func.count()).where(Attendance.student_id == s.id))
        total = total_r.scalar() or 0
        present_r = await db.execute(select(func.count()).where(Attendance.student_id == s.id, Attendance.status == "present"))
        present = present_r.scalar() or 0
        pct = round(present / total * 100, 1) if total > 0 else 0
        report.append({"name": s.name, "total": total, "present": present, "absent": total - present, "percentage": pct})
    return report
```

Test the complete flow:
1. Call POST /api/v1/seed to populate the database
2. Call GET /api/v1/students to see all 5 students
3. Call GET /api/v1/reports/attendance?batch=PFS-2026-July to see the report
4. Verify Rahul has 83.3% (5/6), Priya has 66.7% (4/6), Ananya has 33.3% (2/6)

Congratulations — you have a working backend with 7 API endpoints, database models, validation, seed data, and a report endpoint!
